rollups.text: Dance classes and interests: weekend dance classes (2023-05-20); Saturday hip-hop at Street Beats with instructor Jamal (2023-05-20); seeks a high-energy, street-dance-focused studio and planned to search locally and ask Jamal for recommendations and local events or battles (2023-05-20).

Knitting projects and preferences: finished a purple worsted-weight scarf with subtle texture (2023-05-21); liked its color and texture and chose the same yarn for a beginner beanie, their first hat project; chose a beanie over a slouchy hat (2023-05-21).

Writing practices and tools: uses Scrivener for a short story and Google Docs for journal entries and poetry (2023-05-22); uses the journal for morning pages and occasional poetry, often writing freely without a set subject; finds journaling useful for reflection and processing emotions (2023-05-22). Morning pages inspired poems and short-story scenes; a poem begun as morning pages was revised into a complete poem after a winter walk in a nearby park (2023-02-02). Started the journal on 2023-01-15 and planned to try WriteTrack to track words written and poems finished (2023-05-22).

Guitar and effects: plays guitar and had not previously tried modulation effects (2023-05-22); planned to experiment with chorus and phaser to find a sound suitable for a guitar solo and preferred tone (2023-05-22).

Travel experiences and interests: took an Amtrak trip to visit a sister in Portland, Oregon, in April 2023, enjoyed the scenic route, and recalled the Columbia River Gorge as stunning; expressed interest in scenic train travel (2023-04..2023-05-24). Took a solo Costa Rica yoga-retreat trip around 2018, where the user enjoyed snorkeling and surfing; loves surfing and is enthusiastic about sharing it with their children (circa 2018..2023-12).

Yoga practice and interests: regularly attended yoga near home three times a week and felt energized (2023-05-28); had completed eight weeks of classes and noticed improved flexibility and balance (2023-05-30). Took Hatha and Vinyasa flow classes and expressed interest in trying Kundalini and Sivananda; considered teacher training for the future but wanted to focus on practice for now (2023-05-28). Worked on Boat Pose, Side Plank, shoulder stand, handstand, and forearm stand, and had attended a yoga workshop (2023-05-28).

Art and painting: bought new acrylic paints and brushes about six weeks before 2023-05-29 and experimented with drybrushing and layering, liking the textures and effects (2023-05-29). Developing a cityscape-at-sunset painting using fabric stamping and drybrushing, considering a vintage thrift-store scarf as a stamp and adding trees or foliage (2023-05-29). Appreciates Banksy’s use of art to draw attention to social issues and was interested in seeing street art in person, with Melbourne as a possible starting destination, not a confirmed trip (2023-05-27).

Wellness and meditation: practices yoga regularly (2023-05-28); tried Headspace’s “Sleep” guided meditation and reported that its calming imagery helped quiet stressful thoughts and made falling asleep easier (2023-05-30). Planned to try Insight Timer’s “Body Scan” before bed (2023-05-30).

Plants and gardening interests in Shimokitazawa: wanted flowers or plants to brighten the apartment and planned to visit Green Space first to look for succulents (2023-05-30); was interested in small windowsill planters and considered starting a small indoor herb garden (2023-05-30).

Family and community events: helps organize and curate a local community-center film festival and regularly seeks unusual films (2023-05-25); planned an indie-film night featuring The Farewell, intended to contact local vendors about Chinese-inspired snacks, prepare a brief respectful introduction, and possibly moderate a Q&A (2023-05-25). Met director Lulu Wang at a Rooftop Films summer-series screening in Brooklyn (date unspecified). Planned to attend coworker David and David’s wife Laura’s baby shower and considered a personalized baby blanket; had recently attended friend Emily and her wife Sarah’s welcome-home party for their adopted daughter Lily (2023-05-28).

Mobile personal-expense tracking app project: attended a project-management workshop at the downtown convention center on 2023-05-20..2023-05-21 and wanted to apply agile methods; Rachel discussed effort estimation (2023-05-20..2023-05-21). By 2023-05-25, preparing to start a six-month project with a five-person team including the user; scope was well-defined, some technical details uncertain, and the team knew agile and was open to Scrum or Kanban. Chose three-point estimation and planned to apply it to other user stories and revisit workshop notes (2023-05-25). Approximately four days elapsed from workshop end to the project-planning and estimation discussion; project was expected to run about six months, with no later status recorded.

Japan trip planning: after enjoying an Amtrak trip to Portland in April 2023, planned a Japan trip for March 2024 and asked about Japan Rail Pass value and restrictions (2023-05-24). Expressed interest in Kyoto, kaiseki, and local food; stated no dietary restrictions and thought they would get a Suica card (2023-05-24). Asked about scenic train routes and regional destinations; routes and destinations named by the assistant were suggestions, not confirmed itinerary choices (2023-05-24). The planning conversation occurred about ten months before the intended trip; no completed trip or bookings are recorded.

Hawaii family vacation planning: planned a week-long family trip to Honolulu for December 2023 and sought child-friendly activities, restaurants, snorkeling, luau, and surf lessons (2023-12). Considered Hawaii Nautical for the children’s snorkeling tour, Paradise Cove Luau for the family, and Goofy Foot Surf School for the children’s surf lessons (2023-12); these were tentative ideas, not confirmed bookings. No later trip outcome is recorded.

New York City trip planning: planned a four-day spring trip and wanted to pack light after previously overpacking; had used mix-and-match clothes on a Paris trip (dates unspecified). Considered a portable charger for Google Maps and reported having one and a card-storage phone case by 2023-05-22. Planned remote work and considered Verizon MiFi 8800L or AT&T Netgear Nighthawk M1, without choosing or purchasing either; also wanted to pack snacks to avoid airport prices (2023-05-22). No travel date or outcome recorded.

Community screening of The Farewell: planned an indie-film movie night at the local community center and considered screening The Farewell (2019) (2023-05-25). Planned to contact local vendors about Chinese-inspired snacks and prepare a concise, accurate, respectful introduction to give cultural context; considered a moderator and later said they could moderate while keeping discussion focused and inclusive (2023-05-25). No screening date or completion is recorded.

Grief and coping: on 2023-05-29, reported several loved ones had died in recent months and was approaching the tenth anniversary of the father’s death; considered a slow, reflective week-long return to a childhood lake town to process grief and honor the father (date and place unspecified). Reported vivid dreams about deceased loved ones with varying feelings on waking and planned a dream journal; had tried deep breathing and progressive muscle relaxation inconsistently and was interested in guided imagery, possibly at bedtime or in the morning. No trip or regular imagery practice was confirmed.

Pulmonary embolism and anticoagulation: diagnosed with a small pulmonary embolism in March 2023 and hospitalized for anticoagulation therapy from 2023-03-18 through 2023-03-21 (three days). Later reported taking unspecified blood thinners, had been advised to wear compression stockings, and wanted general information rather than drug-specific advice (2023-05-24). Agreed to consult a healthcare provider about the regimen and specific situation; no medication name, dose, or later clinical outcome was recorded. The May discussion occurred about two months after the hospitalization.

Civilization V as Brazil: at turn 70 (1200 BC), Rio had 3 population and a Caravan nearly complete, São Paulo had 4 population and was producing a Water Mill, and Monarchy was adopted; planned a trade route and settlement near cocoa (2023-05-22). At turn 80 (875 BC), Drama and Poetry had one turn remaining, Rio’s Settler had two turns remaining, the trade route to Colombo had made Colombo an ally and linked iron, Samarkand was a friend, and Landed Elite had been adopted. The user requested clarifications before future action plans and wanted a critical evaluation section at the end (2023-05-22). The reported turns were ten turns apart; no later game state is recorded.
The user reported one completed 5K charity run, in 27 minutes 12 seconds, setting a personal best (2023-04-17).

The user reported one small pulmonary embolism diagnosis in March 2023 and one hospitalization for anticoagulation therapy lasting three days, 2023-03-18 through 2023-03-21. No other embolism or hospitalization is documented here.

Change in yoga experience: after completing eight weeks of classes, the user reported significant improvement in flexibility and said yoga helped flexibility and balance (2023-05-30); earlier, the user had been practicing yoga regularly and felt energized (2023-05-28). The records document reported benefits, not a change in preferred yoga style.

Lighting tasks and preferences: replaced all four burned-out living-room lamp bulbs in about 20 minutes, using stored spares, after putting off the task for weeks (approximately 2023-05-01..2023-05-24). Later considered app-controlled smart bulbs for the living room and wanted warm, soft bedroom lighting; found a pair of adjustable bedroom lamps online and planned to order them during the week of 2023-05-25, but no purchase is confirmed. Also said under-cabinet kitchen lighting needed replacement (2023-05-25).

Allergy concern: on 2023-05-20, said they thought they might have a pollen allergy and that the described hay-fever symptoms sounded like symptoms they had experienced, without specifying symptoms or having a confirmed diagnosis. Asked about over-the-counter and lifestyle measures, appreciated advice about filters and diet, and said they would discuss possible allergies and treatment with a doctor (2023-05-20). No diagnosis or follow-up outcome is recorded.

Family planning: the user and partner Alex discussed having children and were considering starting a family within one or two years of 2023-05-28 (approximately 2024–2025). The user considered communication with Alex important and was thinking about building a support network, inspired by friends Emily and Sarah welcoming their adopted daughter Lily. No later decision or change in plan is recorded.
